purpose: Fix an independent Monte Carlo calibration and power qualification for the endpoint-safe same-species self-field before any empirical genetic outcome or self-detectability synthetic result is inspected.

inference.panel_statistic: W = arithmetic mean of finite held-out species self-field Spearman scores W_s
inference.p_value: upper Monte Carlo p = (1 + number of independent reference W values >= observed W) / (1000 + 1)

qualification.type1_pass: two-sided Wilson 95% upper bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate <= 0.10
qualification.power_pass: two-sided Wilson 95% lower bound of p<=0.05 rejection rate >= 0.80
qualification.failure_interpretation: SELF_DETECTABILITY_NOT_QUALIFIED; empirical cross-species non-transfer cannot be interpreted as lineage-conditioned

execution_only.sharding_semantics: absolute replicate index only; execution partition cannot change world identity

forbidden_after_freeze: changing self-field bandwidth or endpoint exclusion
changing reference/evaluation world counts or seeds
using private-A2 outcomes to define the null threshold
opening empirical genetic outcomes before qualification completes
